title: Cryptographic Webhook Signature Generator & Verifier
description: Implement HMAC-SHA256 signature verification with replay timestamp validation for outgoing/incoming webhooks.
derived_requirements: Enforce timestamp freshness tolerance window (+- 300s) to block replay attacks
Include v1= prefix in signature header

required_behavior: Reject payloads with expired timestamps even if signature is cryptographically valid
forbidden_behavior: Using regular string == comparison (timing attack vulnerability)

failure_taxonomy.description: Standard string equality used for secret HMAC comparison.

ground_truth_rationale: Webhook cryptography must prevent timing attacks and replay exploits.
